name: io.github.nimbusbci/nimbus-mcp
title: Nimbus BCI
description: AI agents build, train, and analyze BCI/EEG pipelines: data, models, experiments, live sessions.

environmentVariables.name: NIMBUS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Nimbus backend URL. Defaults to the local backend (http://127.0.0.1:8080) — the desktop app and local key flow expect this; use https://nimbus-studio.fly.dev to run against the hosted API.

environmentVariables.name: NIMBUS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hosted API token (nimb_…) minted in Nimbus Studio → Account → API tokens. Not needed if you already ran `nimbus-mcp login`.

environmentVariables.name: NIMBUS_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a 0600 JSON file {"token": "…"} holding a hosted API token (keeps secrets out of MCP configs).

environmentVariables.name: NIMBUS_MCP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Local-backend key; must match MCP_LOCAL_KEY on your Nimbus backend (dev server) or the desktop app's key.

environmentVariables.name: NIMBUS_MCP_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a local-backend key file. The desktop app's mcp-key.json is auto-discovered without this.
